versions.changelog:
policy-asset-daily v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Policy-Asset Linkage Daily Report generator.
- Produces a bilingual (Chinese/English) HTML report analyzing policy and market linkages.
- Covers political policy, international macro, energy, commodities/FX, and capital markets.
- Features real-time key prices dashboard and policy-to-asset transmission diagrams.
- Supports one-click language switch and comprehensive news/event aggregation.
